recent_posts.title: Ruby Weekly Issue 798: April 30, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Ruby Weekly issue 798 covers several notable items: Matz has built Spinel, an ahead-of-time self-hosting compiler for a Ruby subset that emits C for native binaries using Prism and type inference; IRB 1.18.0 releases with a new ASCII banner, Prism migration, and improved syntax highlighting; Mustermann 4.0 brings significant performance improvements to the string pattern matching library used by Sinatra, Hanami, and Grape; Perron 1.0 launches as a Rails-based static site generator supporting Markdown, CSV, JSON, and YAML content; and the Ruby on Rails Community Survey 2026 is open for responses.

recent_posts.title: Ruby Weekly Issue 797: April 23, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Ruby Weekly issue 797 covers JRuby 10.1 releasing with Ruby 4.0 compatibility and a new biennial LTS cycle, mruby 4.0 adding pattern matching and memory improvements, and Ruby Central facing financial difficulties with leadership changes. Technical highlights include optimizations to Ruby path methods like File.join outperforming string interpolation, a push for MFA on all RubyGems, and PII filtering for RubyLLM. The release roundup includes oj 3.17 with a safe parser mode, Faker 3.8 with lazy loading, RSpec Tracer 1.1, and several other gem updates. Ecosystem news covers Git 2.54, a Cloudflare CLI preview, PostgreSQL 19 draft release notes, and a teaser from RubyKaigi about Ruby being faster than C.

recent_posts.title: Ruby Weekly Issue 796: April 16, 2026
